title: Multi-input broadband acousto-optic tomography-holography with spectroscopic decomposition: Air-coupled nonlinear damage imaging in composites
authors: Yusheng Ma; Cédric Debusschere; Koen Van Den Abeele; Mathias Kersemans

title: Acousto-optic tomography-holography: quantitative imaging of the 3D nonlinear air-coupled emission field of damaged composites
authors: Yusheng Ma; Cédric Debusschere; Koen Van Den Abeele; Mathias Kersemans
venue_group: Elsevier / Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing
matched_query: acousto-optic tomography holography quantitative 3D nonlinear air-coupled emission damaged composites
summary_en: A quantitative acousto-optic tomography-holography method that reconstructs the three-dimensional nonlinear air-coupled emission field generated by defects in composite plates from scanning laser Doppler vibrometer measurements, enabling remote defect detection and localization.
